stopGap.retirementTrigger: Retire once TARGET Norn authoring (concept({ ... }), pinned packs) hosts the feature ontology natively in a Norn cell (#2005).

title: Native Authoring & CLI Surface
summary: All native Rust `norn` CLI subcommands (`crates/norn-cli/src/`) and TypeScript authoring CLI subcommands (`tools/norn-ts/src/cli.ts`): in-process TypeScript/Python authoring compilation, formatting, profiling, checker admission, explain, dev/init/seed/setup/codegen, offline eval, OpenAPI/source-digest contracts, hosted cell plan/apply, source pull, and MCP.

features.title: Native TypeScript/Python authoring compile, format, profile, question, and dashboard CLI

probe.drive: Exercise both CLIs explicitly against the same fixtures: (1) Rust `norn`: run `norn compile tools/norn-ts/fixtures/quickstart --org example --env local --out <tmp>/rust-task.json`, `norn fmt --check <file>`, `norn profile <file>`, and `norn question <file>` / `norn dashboard <file>`; (2) TypeScript `norn-ts`: run `bun run tools/norn-ts/src/cli.ts compile tools/norn-ts/fixtures/quickstart --org example --env local --out <tmp>/ts-task.json`, `bun run tools/norn-ts/src/cli.ts fmt --check <file>`, `bun run tools/norn-ts/src/cli.ts profile <file>`, and `bun run tools/norn-ts/src/cli.ts question <file>` / `bun run tools/norn-ts/src/cli.ts dashboard <file>`.
probe.observableEndState: Both native Rust `norn` and TypeScript `norn-ts` (`tools/norn-ts/src/cli.ts`) emit identical canonical JSON IR deterministically; both `fmt --check` and `profile` exit 0 on conformant files and refuse non-serializable callbacks or restricted imports.
gotchas: Downstream Norn apps run with zero CI: `norn check --source` refuses `.github/workflows/` inside `norn.json` app directories.

features.title: Governed hosted cell plan/apply and sealed source pull CLI

probe.drive: Target a provisioned hosted cell / Rivet endpoint with two fresh cell baselines so neither CLI replays an already-installed pack: (1) Rust `norn` (takes compiled artifact JSON): compile once via `norn compile tools/norn-ts/fixtures/quickstart --org <org-rust> --env <env-rust> --out <tmp>/artifacts.json`, then run `norn cell plan --url <hosted-url> --org <org-rust> --env <env-rust> --token-env NORN_HOST_TOKEN <tmp>/artifacts.json` followed by `norn cell apply --url <hosted-url> --org <org-rust> --env <env-rust> --token-env NORN_HOST_TOKEN <tmp>/artifacts.json`; (2) TypeScript `norn-ts` (compiles typed sources directly via `worker.ts`): run `bun run tools/norn-ts/src/cli.ts plan tools/norn-ts/fixtures/quickstart --url <hosted-url> --org <org-ts> --env <env-ts> --token-env NORN_HOST_TOKEN` followed by `bun run tools/norn-ts/src/cli.ts apply tools/norn-ts/fixtures/quickstart --url <hosted-url> --org <org-ts> --env <env-ts> --token-env NORN_HOST_TOKEN`; (3) test `norn source pull --crosswalk-env <VAR> --connector <connector.json> --extracted-at-ms <ms>` against a loopback mock/ERPNext endpoint.
probe.observableEndState: Against each fresh hosted cell baseline, both Rust `norn cell plan` and TS `norn-ts plan` print a non-empty diff without mutating cell state and `norn cell apply` / `norn-ts apply` atomically install revision 1 (replaying the same pack reports `unchanged`); against `norn dev`, both fail closed with `409 defs.dev_sources_only`; `norn source pull` issues GET-only reads (`SRC-READ-1`), binds identity solely via the reviewed crosswalk (`SRC-IDENT-1`), and fails closed on read errors (`SRC-LIVE-1`).
gotchas: `norn cell plan|apply` accepts compiled artifact JSON files (or directories of `*.json`), whereas `norn-ts plan|apply` compiles typed `.ts` pack/project sources directly; use a fresh hosted cell baseline per CLI so the second run does not return `unchanged`.

`norn dev` explicitly rejects `/v1/cell/definitions:plan` and `/v1/cell/definitions:apply` with `409 defs.dev_sources_only` (`DEV-ONE-AUTHORITY-1`, `crates/norn-cell-do/src/dev/http.rs`); never target `norn dev` to prove hosted plan/apply.
Never pass bearer tokens or passwords directly as CLI arguments; `cell` and `source` intentionally accept `--token-env` / `--crosswalk-env` only.

features.title: Shared checker admission (`norn check`) and explanation (`norn explain`) CLI

probe.drive: Exercise both CLIs explicitly: (1) Rust `norn`: run `norn check --source tools/norn-ts/fixtures/quickstart --org example --env local` (and `--artifacts <json> --context <ctx>`), then `norn explain concept <id> --defs <json> --format json`; (2) TypeScript `norn-ts`: with `NORN_CHECKER_WASM_PKG` set, run `bun run tools/norn-ts/src/cli.ts check tools/norn-ts/fixtures/quickstart --org example --env local`, and inside a `norn.json` project run `bun run tools/norn-ts/src/cli.ts explain concept <id> --json`.
probe.observableEndState: Both Rust `norn check` and TS `norn-ts check` print a canonical report with `admitted`, diagnostics, and `receiptSha256` without installing definitions; both Rust `norn explain` and TS `norn-ts explain` render the shared `norn/explain@2` JSON/text explanation with honest proof status.
gotchas: `--artifacts` and `--source` are mutually exclusive in Rust `norn check`; `--org` and `--env` must be passed together or both omitted for `norn.json` projects; TS `norn-ts check` and `norn-ts explain` load the checker ABI via `NORN_CHECKER_WASM_PKG`.

features.title: Authoring CLI project init, local dev host, seed, setup, and TypeScript codegen

probe.drive: In a disposable temp directory, run `bun run tools/norn-ts/src/cli.ts init <tmp-dir>`, start `norn dev --port <free-port>` (verifying `.norn/dev.json` with `format: "norn-dev/1"` and `GET /v1/definitions?orgId=<orgId>&environmentId=<environmentId>`), run `norn seed --json`, run `norn codegen --ts <pack-dir> --check`, and verify `norn setup` against a local/cached runtime release.
probe.observableEndState: `init` scaffolds a zero-CI `norn.json` project (no `.github/workflows/`); `dev` serves admitted project sources on loopback with scoped bearer tokens and refuses `/v1/cell/definitions:plan|apply` with `409 defs.dev_sources_only`; `seed` commits fixture data idempotently; `codegen` emits deterministic `.d.ts` bindings.
gotchas: `norn dev` installs definitions exclusively from project sources (`DEV-ONE-AUTHORITY-1`); never share a running user dev cell during verification.

features.title: Local stdio MCP server, capabilities paging, and remote MCP client CLI

probe.drive: Run `norn capabilities`, send a bounded JSON-RPC `tools/list` line over stdio to `norn mcp`, and drive `norn remote list --url <mcp-url> --org <org> --env <env> --token-env <VAR>` plus `norn remote call <tool> --idempotency-key <key>`.
probe.observableEndState: `capabilities` returns paginated tool definitions (`<= 32` per page) and `catalogDigest`; `mcp` serves bounded stdio JSON-RPC; `remote list/call` mirrors the live server catalog and forwards trace/idempotency metadata.
gotchas: A `capabilities` cursor is bound to the working directory and catalog digest; restart pagination without `--cursor` after revisions.

features.title: Offline decision evaluation, OpenAPI contract emission, and HOST-TREE-1 source digest CLI

probe.drive: Run `norn openapi` and diff against `sdks/openapi/norn-api.openapi.json`, run `norn source-digest crates/norn-ir`, and run `norn eval --defs <dir> --org <org> --env <env> --rule <id>` over sample JSON-lines stdin.
probe.observableEndState: `norn openapi` matches the checked-in OpenAPI document byte-for-byte; `norn source-digest` returns deterministic `{digest, files}` skipping hidden entries and `target/` while refusing symlinks; `norn eval` evaluates admitted closures within `--units` budget.
gotchas: `norn source-digest` refuses visible symlinks, sockets/FIFOs, and non-UTF-8 filenames by contract (`HOST-TREE-1`).
